A: A002 gain-only input conditioning; no added temporal history or independent linear capacity
B: Training-only uniform label smoothing with epsilon0.1; ordinary hard-label validation/inference unchanged
hypothesis: Input conditioning and an output-confidence training regularizer may address different limitations. Test whether A+B improves clean held-out-speaker accuracy over A; do not infer complementarity from reduced confidence, loss or gap alone.
motivation_caveat: Primary gain-only CE and wrong-prediction confidence are higher, but Brier improves and ECE is mixed. Smoothing is a hypothesis, not proof of better calibration or accuracy.
novelty: Label smoothing and factorized input gain are established. No new-invention or synergy claim is made.
alternative_reviewed: Existing DTH adds static trainable thresholds plus fast/slow activity-dependent corrections; it is distinct from channel gain but also changes excitability and inference state. Keep as an untested alternative here. Prioritize the already documented output-confidence hypothesis first; do not infer an empirical ranking from source inspection.
mode: All initial arms freshly initialized, same source version; no historical/canonical/speaker-exposed/calibration weights
baseline_authority: config/paper_baseline.yaml / SHD; all shared optimization/preprocessing/stopping settings matched, declared batch/split deviations retained
other_augmentation: None; no B001event deletion or time warp
epsilon_selection: Fixed from established practice before experiment; no epsilon sweep on either pair or official tests
primary_metric: Clean held-out-speaker validation accuracy; A+B minus A
support: Ordinary validation CE and learning curves; report ordinary hard-target training CE separately from smoothed training objective
advance: Advance only an accuracy improvement supported by curves/loss. Extend matched arms30->75only if technically sound and promising or genuinely inconclusive/still learning. A smaller gap or lower CE alone is insufficient. Inspect B-only before heavy transfer if needed to distinguish generic regularization from complementarity.
pair_sensitivity: Only shortlisted candidates plus matched controls use the existing fixed6/10pair, with fresh weights. No pair search or tuning there; it is a sensitivity diagnostic, not independent confirmation.
estimated_initial_compute: About15-20minutes for3arms at30epochs from prior9-11second SHD epochs plus startup; verify actual runtime after launch
implementation_requirements: Explicit opt-in registered objective and experiment configs through existing runner; ordinary defaults unchanged
Preserve original temporal aggregation, hard integer targets, ignored-target masks and neuron parameters
Train-only smoothed CE; ordinary hard-label validation/test CE and predictions
Zero added inference parameters/state/forward passes; log hard training CE without changing gradients
Record objective/epsilon deviations and distinct protocol metadata in configs/receipts/progress
Non-training CPU/CUDA correctness and default-parity checks plus actual runner dry runs before launch
Finish all source/config/test changes before fresh queue; retain source/resume guards
transfer_policy: Promising B requires matched SSC/ECG validation screens before final freeze; no automatic full training of every idea. Final Baseline/A/B/A+B canonical SHD* weights must be trained on their own split and replicated under frozen settings.
independent_seed_caveat: Repeated seed42controls are not independent training seeds. Existing CUDA replay variability remains a limitation; final matching-seed replication is required.
